#| echo: false
#| output: false
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)

# 1. Function to parse a BOLD JSONL file into a flat dataframe
parse_bold_file <- function(file_path) {
    # Read file line by line (JSONL format)
    lines <- readLines(file_path, warn = FALSE)
    lines <- lines[trimws(lines) != ""] # Remove empty lines
  
    map_dfr(lines, function(line) {
        record <- fromJSON(line, simplifyVector = FALSE)
        q_id <- record$seqid
        
        # Check if this query returned any hits
        if (length(record$results) == 0) {
            return(tibble(
                query_id = q_id,
                hit_id = NA_character_,
                bitscore = NA_real_,
                evalue = NA_real_,
                pident = NA_real_,
                qcovhsp = NA_real_,
                overlap = NA_integer_,
                mismatch = NA_integer_,
                gaps = NA_integer_,
                top_id = "No Hit",
                taxonomy = "None"
            ))
        }
        
        # Iterate over all hits for the query
        hits_list <- record$results
        map_dfr(names(hits_list), function(h_name) {
            h <- hits_list[[h_name]]
            tax <- h$taxonomy
            
            # Determine best Identification name (Species -> Genus -> Family)
            top_id <- "Unknown"
            if (!is.null(tax$species) && tax$species != "") {
                top_id <- tax$species
            } else if (!is.null(tax$genus) && tax$genus != "") {
                top_id <- tax$genus
            } else if (!is.null(tax$family) && tax$family != "") {
                top_id <- tax$family
            }
            
            # Build a full taxonomic lineage string
            tax_vec <- c(tax$phylum, tax$class, tax$order, tax$family, tax$genus, tax$species)
            tax_vec <- tax_vec[!is.null(tax_vec) & tax_vec != ""]
            tax_str <- if (length(tax_vec) > 0) paste(tax_vec, collapse = " > ") else "Unknown"
            
            tibble(
                query_id = q_id,
                hit_id = h_name,
                bitscore = as.numeric(h$bitscore),
                evalue = as.numeric(h$evalue),
                pident = as.numeric(h$pident),
                qcovhsp = as.numeric(h$qcovhsp),
                overlap = as.integer(h$overlap),
                mismatch = as.integer(h$mismatch),
                gaps = as.integer(h$gaps),
                top_id = top_id,
                taxonomy = tax_str
            )
        })
    })
}

# 2. Load and combine data from all input files
bold_hits <- map_dfr(bold_files, function(f) {
    if (file.exists(f)) {
        parse_bold_file(f) %>% mutate(source_file = basename(f))
    } else {
        warning(paste("File not found:", f))
        tibble()
    }
})

if (nrow(bold_hits) == 0) {
    stop("No valid BOLD results found in the provided JSONL files.")
}

bold_hits <- dplyr::bind_cols(
    bold_hits,
    evaluate_hit_quality_df(bold_hits$pident, bold_hits$qcovhsp)
)

# 3. Create Main Summary Table (Level 1) - Top Hit per Query
summary_bold_df <- bold_hits %>%
    group_by(query_id) %>%
    arrange(evalue, desc(bitscore)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(query_id) %>%
    select(query_id, top_id, hit_id, pident, qcovhsp, evalue, bitscore, qc_symbol, qc_sym_class, qc_row_class, qc_reason)


# Dynamic theme connecting reactable to our custom CSS variables
dynamic_theme <- reactableTheme(
    color = "var(--tbl-text)",
    backgroundColor = "var(--tbl-bg)",
    borderColor = "var(--tbl-border)",
    stripedColor = "var(--tbl-stripe)",
    highlightColor = "var(--tbl-highlight)",
    cellPadding = "8px 12px"
)

# Helper function to generate BOLD URL links
generate_bold_link <- function(value) {
    if(is.na(value)) return("-")
    # Extract the Process ID (everything before the first '|')
    proc_id <- sub("\\|.*", "", value)
    # Return the formatted HTML link with stopPropagation
    sprintf('<a href="https://portal.boldsystems.org/record/%s" target="_blank" class="bold-link" onclick="event.stopPropagation();" style="color: var(--tbl-accent); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;">%s</a>', proc_id, value)
}
